title: My Spirit on Thy Care
description: My Spirit on Thy Care in Tonic Solfa to SOUTHWELL, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Henry Francis Lyte wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 369.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to SOUTHWELL; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: My spir-it on Thy care, Blest Sa-vior, I re-cline; Thou wilt not leave me to de-spair, For Thou art Love di-vine.

lines: Thou wilt not leave me to despair,
In Thee I place my trust,
I know Thee good, I know Thee just,
And count Thy choice the best.
Safe in Thy breast my head I hide
It must be good for me;
Secure of having Thee in all,

licence: Public domain: Henry Francis Lyte died in 1847.
credits: Words by Henry Francis Lyte (1793–1847), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to SOUTHWELL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
